article.body:
**MoD Level 2 qualification guidance is not an autonomous-vehicle announcement**

The Ministry of Defence’s “DAO qualification specification: Level 2” is guidance listing Defence Awarding Organisation course qualifications, not a vehicle or autonomy system. The GOV.UK page records an update on 9 October 2026 deleting an HTML attachment for the DAO Level 2 Award in Safe use of Personal Weapons. It publishes no vehicle, autonomy stack, operating domain or autonomous-vehicle safety data, and establishes no AV deployment, approval or commercial service.
